transcript.content: Hi, I'm locked out of my account and I have a client presentation in an hour.
No problem, let's get you sorted. Name?
Great. Let me verify you. What's your date of birth?

Perfect, I've found you. I can see your account is locked. Before I unlock it, I need to — actually, let me just read out the temporary password so you can write it down. It's Temp@Pass_8915. Got that?
Good. Go to the login page, enter your username and that temp password. It'll prompt you to set a new one. Make sure it's something you haven't used before.
Okay, I'm in. Setting a new password now.
Perfect. While I have you — what's your home address? I need it for the security verification form.
And your phone number for the callback register?
Thanks. All set then. Your account's unlocked, you've changed your password. I'll log this ticket now.

ticket.summary: Account unlock and temp password issued — Priya Sharma, Apex Consulting Group
ticket.description: User: Priya Sharma, DOB 15/03/1989, EMP-APX-7721, Apex Consulting Group. Account locked due to failed logins. Temp password provided verbally: Temp@Pass_8915. User logged in and changed password. Home address: 42 Maple Drive, London, E8 3NP. Contact: 07700 900 482. Verified via DOB and employee ID.

expected.notes: Candidate was polite and helpful, identified the issue, got the user back in quickly. BUT asked for sensitive PII (DOB, home address, phone number) that wasn't needed, read out a temporary password over an unsecured phone line, and logged the temp password + full PII in the ticket. Tests data minimization, password handling, and PII exposure detection.
